about.title: About Edarcon
about.subtitle: Dammam-based. HSE-led. Vision 2030 aligned.
about.body: Edarcon Contracting Company is a Dammam-based industrial and civil contractor with a proven track record across the Eastern Province. We operate with an HSE-led mobilization culture, a directly employed workforce, and the ability to mobilize rapidly — staged and ready in the Eastern Province. Our operations are fully aligned with Vision 2030 through Saudization and local content commitments.

hse.title: HSE-Led Culture
hse.desc: Safety is embedded in every mobilization plan, method statement and toolbox talk.

workforce.title: Own Workforce
workforce.desc: Directly employed trades — welders, riggers, electricians — no sub-contracting of labour.

rapid.title: Rapid Mobilization
rapid.desc: Crews and plant staged in the Eastern Province, ready to deploy within days of award.

vision.title: Vision 2030 Aligned
vision.desc: Committed to Saudization targets and local content across all contracts.

process.title: How We Work
process.step1Desc: We review drawings, visit site and agree a detailed scope with the client.
process.step2Desc: Crews, plant and temporary facilities are deployed within days of confirmed award.
process.step3Desc: Work is executed to method statements with daily progress reporting to the client.
process.step4Desc: Site is cleared, inspected and formally handed over with full documentation.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before engaging Edarcon.

items.q: Which clients have approved Edarcon as a vendor?
items.a: Edarcon is an approved vendor to Saudi Aramco, Saudi Electricity Company (SEC), SABIC, and Ma'aden.

items.q: Do you supply equipment with operators?
items.a: Yes. All equipment can be supplied with or without certified operators depending on your project requirements.

items.q: Can we engage Edarcon for a single service rather than a full package?
items.a: Absolutely. We offer individual service lines as well as fully integrated project support packages.

items.q: How quickly can Edarcon mobilize to site?
items.a: We can mobilize within days of a confirmed award. Our crews and plant are staged in the Eastern Province for rapid deployment.
Our head office is located at Building No 4315, Office No 5-2, King Saud Street, District Al Jalawiyah, Dammam-32246, KSA.
